case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.quote: The appellant herein was convicted and sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for life
number_of_accused.reason: A single appellant is convicted; one accused is consistent with the text.

accused_gender.reason: Accused is male (referred to as 'his wife', 'he' throughout).

accused_age.reason: The judgment never states the accused's age; 35 is not supported.

accused_religion.reason: Religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.correct_value: Irregular casual labourer, taking casual jobs for sustenance
accused_occupation.quote: although the appellant was irregular, he used to take on casual jobs for his sustenance
accused_occupation.reason: The judgment does state his occupation as casual jobs.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No explicit socioeconomic status is stated; only casual jobs and a crowded locality are mentioned.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victim is the appellant's wife, hence female.

victim_age.reason: The victim's age is not stated anywhere in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Accused is the victim's husband, i.e. spouse.

offence_category.reason: Offence is murder under s.302 IPC.

statutory_provisions.reason: Core provisions s.302 and s.84 IPC are covered; Evidence Act and s.299 references are minor omissions.

weapon.quote: assaulting her with a chopper on her neck

evidence_type.quote: The ocular evidence was corroborated by medical evidence
evidence_type.reason: Ocular, medical and recovery evidence are all relied upon.

confession.quote: According to PW5, the appellant had confessed to the crime.
confession.reason: The judgment records that the appellant confessed to neighbours and PW5.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: Whilst he had brutally and callously committed the murder of his wife
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Brutal, callous murder and blood-stained chopper possession are supported.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: he did not cause any hurt or discomfort to the child
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Facts are stated, but the court used them to negate insanity, not as mitigation.

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted and sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for life under Section 302 IPC
trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches the trial court conviction and life sentence.

high_court_outcome.quote: dismissed the criminal appeal filed by the appellant and thereby affirmed his conviction under Section 302 IPC
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed the appeal and affirmed conviction.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal; conviction stands.

offence_finally_established.quote: the appellant has committed the murder of his wife
offence_finally_established.reason: Murder under s.302 IPC was established.

imprisonment_type.reason: Sentence was rigorous imprisonment for life.

imprisonment_years.reason: Life imprisonment has no fixed term; null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts without the court's conclusions, e.g. the accused claimed insanity; the courts rejected it
neutral_facts.quote: but the courts found no evidence he was mentally ill at the time of the crime
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurate, but statements like 'courts found' and 'suggested he understood' reveal the outcome.

offence_severity.quote: sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for life
offence_severity.reason: Severity reflects life imprisonment for murder.

attempt_completion.reason: Offence was completed; the wife died.

physical_harm.quote: the injuries could have been caused with a weapon which was seized from the appellant
physical_harm.reason: Fatal neck injuries from chopper are supported by post-mortem evidence.

number_of_offences.reason: Only one offence (murder) was charged and upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No property loss is discussed; 'Not applicable' is a reasonable classification.

premeditation_planning.reason: The judgment does not discuss premeditation or planning, nor 'without hesitation'.

motive.correct_value: Appellant's suspicion that wife had been cheating on him
motive.quote: till 8 today she had been cheating upon me
motive.reason: The appellant's statement at the scene gives a stated motive of suspected infidelity.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: The ocular evidence has been corroborated by medical evidence.
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Accurately summarises the accepted ocular, medical and weapon evidence.

witness_credibility.quote: the evidence given by PW1 to PW5 is unimpeachable
witness_credibility.reason: Matches the High Court's view of PW1 to PW5 and DW1 evidence.

post_offence_conduct.quote: he made up his mind to insure that the child be put into proper care and custody after the murder
post_offence_conduct.reason: Post-offence conduct and its use against insanity are supported.

trial_duration.reason: Offence, trial, High Court and Supreme Court dates match the judgment.

legal_representation.quote: T.V. George, Manjula Gupta for the Appellant
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for both sides match the judgment.

investigation_status.correct_value: FIR registered on PW1's statement (Exb.P1); charge sheet not mentioned; trial completed
investigation_status.quote: The FIR was registered on the basis of the statement Exb.P1 made by PW1
investigation_status.reason: FIR and trial are supported, but charge sheet filing is not mentioned.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Insanity plea reportedly not taken at trial, though the trial court considered Section 84 defence
procedural_irregularity.quote: no such plea was taken at the time of the trial
procedural_irregularity.reason: The judgment notes the insanity plea was not raised at trial, so 'None noted' overlooks it.

appeal_history.quote: the High Court of Kerala at Ernakulum dismissed the criminal appeal
appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court affirmance and SC dismissal are all supported.

prosecution_argument.quote: the appellant had confessed to all of them that he had killed his wife
prosecution_argument.reason: Summary of prosecution case and conduct-based inference is consistent with the judgment.

defence_argument.correct_value: Defence argued the entire story was unbelievable, the defence was wrongly discarded, and paranoid schizophrenia impaired the accused's mind at the time.
defence_argument.reason: Insanity argument is covered, but the counsel's contention that the story was unbelievable is omitted.

legal_principle_applied.correct_value: Accused must prove insanity on a preponderance standard, no higher than civil proceedings; a rebuttable presumption of sanity applies.
legal_principle_applied.quote: the burden of proof upon him is no higher than that rests upon a party to civil proceedings
legal_principle_applied.reason: The standard is not 'beyond reasonable doubt' for the accused; it is civil-level proof.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Listed precedents match those relied on in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.quote: the appellant was capable of knowing the nature of the act and the consequences thereof
sentencing_rationale.reason: The judgment reasons about conviction and mens rea, not about sentence.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No mitigating factors are recognised by the court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Brutal and callous murder of the wife, per the court's observation
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: Whilst he had brutally and callously committed the murder of his wife
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The court expressly characterised the murder as brutal and callous, an aggravating observation.

other_sentence_order.reason: No other sentence order is mentioned.
